description: BIGNUMERIC ≡ decimal(76,38). Real BQ emits precision=77 in the Avro schema. Stored as DECIMAL(38, 9) locally (DuckDB caps precision at 38) — values must fit in 29 integer digits + 9 decimal places. The fixture value here stays within DECIMAL(38, 9); wire encoder still pads to scale 38 for BQ fidelity.
insertSql: INSERT INTO $TABLE VALUES (1, CAST('0' AS BIGNUMERIC)), (2, CAST('-1.23456789' AS BIGNUMERIC)), (3, NULL)
